name: seedlab
description: Seed Lab: one plugin, for redesigning a web page in your own project.

plugins.name: seedlab
plugins.description: Redesign a page in your own codebase so it stops looking AI-generated. Seed Lab draws several directions that reorganise the page, each built on an object from outside web design with a set palette; Claude sketches them for you to choose from, rebuilds the page in your stack, and a second model reviews the screenshots. The wording behind it was picked in blind votes.
